description: This file provides utilities to integrate with Google Calendar via OAuth tokens, including functions to retrieve the access token from a Supabase session, fetch calendar events using Google Calendar API, convert raw Google events into meeting objects suitable for the application's data model, and handle deduplication of events based on external IDs. It also includes a heuristic to check if the current session has the appropriate calendar read scopes.

methods.name: getGoogleAccessToken()
methods.description: Retrieves the Google OAuth access token from the current Supabase session, checking multiple possible locations in the session object.

methods.name: fetchGoogleEvents({ accessToken, timeMin, timeMax, maxResults = 250, singleEvents = true, orderBy = 'startTime', calendarId = 'primary', } = {})
methods.description: Fetches events from Google Calendar API using the provided OAuth token, with optional parameters to specify time range, max results, and other query options.

methods.name: toMeetingObjects(events = [], userId)
methods.description: Converts raw Google Calendar event objects into application-specific meeting objects, extracting relevant fields and mapping attendees.

methods.name: mergeWithoutDuplicates(existing = [], incoming = [])
methods.description: Merges new meeting objects into an existing collection, avoiding duplicates based on the external_event_id field.

methods.name: hasCalendarScope()
methods.description: Heuristically checks whether the user's current session has the necessary scopes to read Google Calendar events.

ctags.name: fetchGoogleEvents
ctags.signature: ({ accessToken, timeMin, timeMax, maxResults = 250, singleEvents = true, orderBy = 'startTime', calendarId = 'primary', } = {})
